title: The Broken Yearbook
author: Quentin Lockridge
blurb: Marguerite Brightwater, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
